canonical_title: NVIDIA minority investment in Cloverleaf Infrastructure for AI data-center development
aliases: Nvidia invests in data center developer Cloverleaf Infrastructure
treatment: Treat as NVIDIA's direct investment in powered-land/data-center development capacity. Do not merge with the separate $500B compute-financing platform unless a later development explicitly links the capital structures.
known_facts: NVIDIA made a minority investment in privately held Cloverleaf Infrastructure to accelerate U.S. AI data-center site development.
Financial terms were not disclosed by the companies; Wall Street Journal reporting said the expected investment was several hundred million dollars.
Cloverleaf works with utilities, energy providers and investors to secure power and related infrastructure for data-center sites.
Cloverleaf will deploy NVIDIA DSX to optimize site selection, power, cooling and compute-infrastructure decisions.
Cloverleaf said it has delivered multiple gigawatt-scale projects across North America since its 2024 founding.
reinclude_only_if: Official investment amount or ownership percentage is disclosed.
A named Cloverleaf site or customer reaches a signed power, land, financing or compute deployment milestone tied to NVIDIA.
Material DSX deployment details, capacity, schedule or economics are disclosed.
The investment is formally connected to NVIDIA's compute-financing platforms or another major financing structure.
notes: Reuters timestamp 2026-08-21 14:35:15 UTC = 2026-08-21 23:35:15 JST, five minutes after the prior LLM Night Lite boundary.
